entities.summary: Mikko Kärnä is a Finnish politician. He served as a member of the Parliament of Finland from 30 April 2015 until 12 June 2018 for the Lapland constituency. He was also the mayor of Enontekiö from 2012 to 2015. He is a member of the Centre Party. Mikko Kärnä was a military leaders & commanders from Espoo (b. 1980-12-08, Espoo). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to geopolitics.
